anna_sales: Quick heads up — NovaCorp POC hitting intermittent 429s during this morning's demo (~10:05 PT). They see per-route errors on /v1/generate even though their token dashboard shows plenty left. Can we swarm?

matt_sre: Can you share a sample request_id + timestamp? Are they streaming responses or using sync generation? Any per-route overrides on their tenant config?

anna_sales: They said sync generation. Sample from their logs:
```
ts=2026-03-18T17:05:12Z level=warn tenant=novacorp route=/v1/generate req_id=rc_3gk2 amt_tokens=4520 err=rate_limit_exceeded code=429 window=60s
```
Also they forwarded a curl from their demo client: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-novacorp" -d '{"model":"rwd-v1","input":"..."}'`

olivia_eng: Hmm — token accounting mismatch can happen if prompt prefix or system messages are large. Do we have the invoice/billing token counts separate from per-route token buckets?

sam_ml: Also check whether they're hitting per-route *request* caps vs per-tenant *token* caps. Embeddings/extra eval calls can consume token budget even if the route is /v1/generate in the client. Any concurrent background jobs?

matt_sre: @anna_sales can you drop the tenant config dump (redact secrets) and one full request payload that hit 429? I want request_id and the rate-limiter decision log from the edge (rate_limiter logs).

anna_sales: Pasting minimal tenant config (redacted):
```
tenant=novacorp
per_route_cap:/v1/generate = 300 req/min
per_tenant_token_cap = 25000 tokens/day
burst_window = 60s
```
And request payload (trimmed): `{"input":"<~8k chars prompt>","max_tokens":1024}` — they were demoing long-context summarization so prompt was large.

matt_sre: That explains it — a single demo request with ~8k prompt + generation = ~=4500 tokens can chew through the per_route_cap in token-weighted accounting if our limiter applies token weighting per request. The logs show `amt_tokens=4520` so per-route limit likely configured as requests/min not tokens, but we recently switched to token-weighted enforcement for /v1/generate in canary which would treat that as multiple units.

olivia_eng: Confirmed: canary change last week enabled token-weighted rate limiting on generation routes for a subset of tenants behind the feature flag. Looks like novacorp got included via the sales QA slice.

matt_sre: Immediate remediation options:
- temporary per-route cap bump for novacorp while demo completes
- flip feature-flag off for novacorp to fallback to request-count enforcement
- ask customer to reduce prompt size for demo (short-term)

anna_sales: Sales asks for the least-disruptive: temp bump now, followed by a fix to avoid silently hitting canary behavior in future demos.

matt_sre: I'll apply a quick per-route cap increase and tag as emergency. @olivia_eng can you also patch the rollout gating so sales-demote tenants aren't auto-included?

deploy-bot: config_change: apply -> tenant=novacorp key=per_route_cap:/v1/generate old=300 new=1200 id=cfg_892 ts=2026-03-18T17:12:45Z

olivia_eng: I've removed novacorp from the token-weighted canary slice and opened issue INF-667 to add a pre-demo checklist for sales (feature-flag audit + prompt size check).

sam_ml: FYI behavior note for docs: when token-weighted enforcement is enabled we account request cost = prompt_tokens + predicted_generated_tokens. Large single requests will tip customers faster than many small requests. We'll add a short explainer.

anna_sales: NovaCorp confirmed demo continued successfully after the bump — no more 429s. Thanks everyone! :tada:

matt_sre: Follow-ups:
- INF-667 assigned to olivia_eng (add checklist + gating)
- CFG-892 documented and scheduled to be auto-reverted to 300/min after 24h unless sales requests extension
- Update KB: difference between request-count and token-weighted rate limiting (sam_ml)

olivia_eng: Noted, will own INF-667.

sam_ml: I'll draft the KB and include example calculations and mitigation tips (split long prompts, stream generation, use dedicated capacity for sustained heavy prompts).

anna_sales: Great — please ping me when KB is live so I can copy into the customer follow-up. :thumbsup:

matt_sre: Closing this thread for now, reopening if anything else pops up.
